changeSet.author: theodoreromeos
changeSet.sql:
-- 1. ORDERS CREATE TABLE orders ( order_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, customer_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, order_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, date_updated TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL );
-- 2. ORDER LINE CREATE TABLE order_line ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, product_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, price NUMERIC NOT NULL, order_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT order_fk FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id), CONSTRAINT unique_product_per_order UNIQUE (product_id, order_id) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS orders; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS order_line;
